options.title: Lipton Was a Glasgow Grocer Who Bought His Own Tea Gardens
options.first_line: The name on your tea bag belonged to a Glasgow grocer who bought his own tea gardens.
options.first_frame: A typeset record card, 'opened his first shop in Glasgow, {fact1}' highlighted in yellow; then a cut to a box of yellow-tagged Lipton tea bags.

options.title: Thomas Lipton Opened One Shop in {fact1}. It's on Your Tea Bag
options.first_line: Thomas Lipton opened one grocery shop in Glasgow in {fact1}, and his name is still on your tea bag.
options.first_frame: The record card with the year {fact1} highlighted, over an old Glasgow street; then the Lipton tea box.

options.title: Your Lipton Tea Bag Is Named After a Glasgow Shopkeeper
options.first_line: Your Lipton tea bag is named after a shopkeeper from Glasgow.
options.first_frame: The record card of Lipton's first Glasgow shop with its year highlighted; then a Lipton tea bag dipping into a cup.

why: It opens on a tea bag the viewer actually uses and asks how a Glasgow shopkeeper's name ended up on it, without giving away the answer the way A's tea-gardens twist does.
